'''Ryloth Wine''' was located in [[Daiyu City]] on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]]. It shared its name with [[Ryloth]],<ref name="Kenobi" /> a planet in the [[Outer Rim Territories]];<ref name="Databank">{{Databank|ryloth|Ryloth}}</ref> and the [[Wine|alcoholic beverage]].<ref name="Wine in Dreams">{{StoryCite|story=The Wine in Dreams|book=Canto Bight (novella collection)}}</ref> The name was printed on a [[Color|green]] [[Aurebesh]] sign, although the first character was mirror-inverted. It was located next to [[The Den]]. Another sign with the same design but in brown and yellow could be seen in a different street in the [[city]].<ref name="Kenobi" />
